name: tray
description: Trays are containers that display transient content such as menus, options, additional actions, and more. They only exist on mobile experiences and are used for exposing types of content that may be too overwhelming for popovers.

lifecycle.deprecatedComment: Archive-only: Spectrum 1 only. The Figma Web POC has no tray, React Spectrum S2 has a TODO to add it back and SWC gen2 has none. Its legacy records are already deprecated, so nothing live is left. Revive it only from a Spectrum 2 mobile source.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Tray surface that slides in from an edge.

anatomyReview.notes: Archived as Spectrum 1 only (owner decision A8, 2026-11-20; the A5 floating-action-button rule). No S2 source found, so the parts are inferred and stay a draft; the earlier note citing a Figma S2 Web tray could not be confirmed. The grip part follows the panels: drag-handle.
